主要内容: On January 31, 2020, Nicholas Financial, Inc. announced a partnership with DealerCenter as a Preferred Lender. The press release, attached as Exhibit 99.1, details this collaboration. The partnership is intended to enhance the Company's lending capabilities and expand its market reach. This development is significant for Nicholas Financial, Inc. as it marks a strategic move to strengthen its position in the financial services sector. The information provided in the press release is not deemed to be 'filed' under Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, nor is it subject to the liabilities of that Section or Sections 11 and 12(a)(2) of the Securities Act of 1933. The press release is not incorporated by reference into any filing of the Company unless expressly incorporated by specific reference into such filing. The Company's Chief Executive Officer, Douglas Marohn, signed the report on behalf of the Registrant on January 31, 2020. This partnership is a key event for Nicholas Financial, Inc. and may influence its business operations and strategic direction in the financial services industry.
